classification: Public release 1.2.0: merge, tag, image publication, desktop installers, Community Apps template and default-branch advisory recheck, each read back after the fact. No live deployment and no operator data step is part of this record.

ci.limit: CI excludes integration tests and a named deselection list; it is not the full local suite.

tag_and_release.notes: CHANGELOG 1.2.0 section with documentation links pointed at the tag.

desktop_installers.release_job: Downloaded the six installer artifacts only; the eight-file guard passed before attaching.
limits: Installers are unsigned by product decision. None was installed or launched from the release page; packaged journeys are recorded separately for the Linux package only.

read_back: All four tags resolve to the index digest the workflow recorded.
The index carries linux/amd64 and linux/arm64; both image configs carry the merge commit as revision label and build identity.
Each platform has an SPDX 2.3 SBOM (277 and 279 packages) and a SLSA provenance statement naming this workflow run as builder.
The Docker Hub overview step succeeded.

published_image_checks.method: Image pulled by digest (amd64). Startup-guard scenarios, then an in-place upgrade of a fresh public 1.1.9 single-container volume.
observed: URL-only strong password proceeded to the database wait; legacy, missing and explicit legacy passwords exited 1; the compatibility flag warned and proceeded.
Upgrade reported ready in about 9 seconds with version 1.2.0, ten migrations, zero error lines, a non-root app process, transferred library ownership and build identity 0b2cb68c.

image.bundle_scrub: The private banned-token list matched 0 of 78 web bundle files extracted from the candidate image built from ea40c499; a control pattern confirmed the scanner worked.
limits: The arm64 image was not started from the registry; it was started only from the local rehearsal build (R2132).
Attestations were read through the registry client; no independent signature verification was run.

community_apps_template.sync_job: Stopped at its write step because no template write token is configured, as at 1.1.9.
manual_path: Before the update the public feed file was byte-equal to the canonical 1.1.8 rendering, so it carried no foreign edits.
The template was rendered from tag v1.2.0 with the workflow's own substitution (9144 bytes, LF only, sha256 b4702f72e2c5b6fc2f08a407f7225e36a9176a3fe0fb398b248f7a0aa458fd02).
That one file was updated through the repository contents API against the blob it replaced (feed commit f22a656e).
The file was read back through the API and the raw URL and is byte-equal to the rendering.
Only the failed job was re-run; it found the feed already matching and the workflow now records success.
community_apps_template.limit: The write token is still not configured, so the next release needs the same manual step unless it is added.

limits: Dependabot records only; secret scanning is disabled and no code-scanning analysis exists for the repository.
Dependabot opened new update pull requests against the default branch after the merge; they are not part of this release.

not_done: No live deployment: the running household instance was not touched.
Operator data steps (credential conversion, save-key migration, legacy save audit) were not run anywhere.
The Compose stack upgrade and a database with real data were not rehearsed.
